title: Upkeep for buoyant (2026)
description:
* [ ] `usethis::use_readme_rmd()`
* [x] `usethis::use_tidy_description()`
* [x] `usethis::use_package_doc()`
Consider letting usethis manage your `@importFrom` directives here. `usethis::use_import_from()` is handy for this.
* [x] Align the names of `R/` files and `test/` files for workflow happiness. The docs for `usethis::use_r()` include a helpful script. `usethis::rename_files()` may be be useful.
* [x] Add alt-text to pictures, plots, etc; see <https://posit.co/blog/knitr-fig-alt/> for examples

Set up or update GitHub Actions. \
      Updating workflows to the latest version will often fix troublesome actions:
* [x] `usethis::use_github_action('check-standard')`
* [x] `usethis::use_github_action('pkgdown')`
* [x] `usethis::use_github_action('test-coverage')`

<sup>Created on 2026-01-13 with `usethis::use_upkeep_issue()`, using [usethis v3.2.1](https://usethis.r-lib.org)</sup>

title: Release buoyant 0.1.0
description:
First release:

* [x] `usethis::use_cran_comments()`
* [x] Update (aspirational) install instructions in README
* [x] Proofread `Title:` and `Description:`
* [x] Check that all exported functions have `@return` and `@examples`
* [x] Check that `Authors@R:` includes a copyright holder (role 'cph')
* [x] Check [licensing of included files](https://r-pkgs.org/license.html#sec-code-you-bundle)
* [x] Review <https://github.com/DavisVaughan/extrachecks>

Prepare for release:

* [x] `git pull`
* [x] `urlchecker::url_check()`
* [x] `devtools::check(remote = TRUE, manual = TRUE)`
* [x] `devtools::check_win_devel()`
* [x] `git push`
* [ ] Draft blog post

Submit to CRAN:

* [x] `usethis::use_version('minor')`
* [x] `devtools::submit_cran()`
* [x] Approve email

Wait for CRAN...

* [x] Accepted :tada:
* [ ] Finish & publish blog post
* [ ] Add link to blog post in pkgdown news menu
* [ ] `usethis::use_github_release()`
* [ ] `usethis::use_dev_version(push = TRUE)`
* [ ] Share on social media
* [ ] Slack link to blog post, bluesky, and linkedin in #open-source-comms
